scope: Attention-mass observation at wrong-digit decision steps on CPU backend, aggregated over semantically labelled prompt regions. Interpretability evidence about a behavioral mechanism; not a proof, not fresh confirmatory holdout, not CUDA-path evidence.

limitations: Attention mass is a correlational observation at the decision step, not a causal attribution; activation interventions remain future work.
Sliding-window layers see the full context here (<512 tokens), so mass distributions are not truncated evidence.
Region labels derive from prompt-string spans; a token overlapping two spans is counted under both.
CPU backend only; CUDA-path attention is unobserved.
